root.label: Miami Carol City and Grayson postgame brawl

events.label: Miami Carol City and Grayson postgame brawl

slots.name: final score
slots.sentence: Grayson had just defeated Carol City 10-9 when tensions boiled over during the postgame handshake line.

slots.name: score margin
slots.sentence: What began as a handshake line between Grayson and Carol City football players following a one-point game quickly descended into a chaotic postgame fight Friday night, Oct. 2.

slots.name: number of groups
slots.sentence: Eventually, the groups were pulled apart, and the field began to clear.
